character: A large Summit County resort right beside I-70 whose terrain is naturally sorted by difficulty, with easier runs on the west side and steeper terrain to the east, plus high open bowls on top. It has three base areas (West Village / Union Creek, Center Village and East Village).
learning: Reference note: the West Village / Union Creek base is aimed at beginners and families, with gentle terrain nearby, and the resort runs its own ski and ride school. Confirm current learning lifts, carpets and lesson products.

source.note: Search summary of 2026-27 opening-date roundups (Powder, "Ikon Pass Reveals Ski Resort Opening Dates for 2026-27 Season"; Freeskier; Unofficial Networks, 10 and 17 Sep 2026). Conditions permitting — confirm on the resort site.

Search summary of Uncover Colorado's "2026-27 Colorado Ski Resorts Season Opening and Closing Dates": Copper opens Nov. 6, 2026 and closes May 2, 2027. Third-party roundup — confirm on coppercolorado.com.

season.notes: 2026-27: planned Nov. 6, 2026 opening (Ikon opening-date roundups) and a May 2, 2027 closing (Uncover Colorado roundup). Both are search-summary facts; confirm on coppercolorado.com.
